stories.title: Council thanks Flint tower block residents after night of fire crew training
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has thanked residents of a Flint tower block for their patience during a fire service training exercise on Monday night. North Wales Fire and Rescue Service crews carried out the exercise at Castle Heights, the council’s 15-storey block of 84 flats in the centre of Flint. stories.title: Flintshire Council left with “very little room” as emergency fund shrinks to £766,000
stories.summary: Flintshire Council’s emergency fund is forecast to fall to £766,000 by the end of March as the authority heads for a £7.6m overspend. stories.title: Flintshire petrol average falls 4.6p in a week but no forecourt near RAC’s 150p forecast
stories.summary: Drivers in Flintshire are paying up to 14p a litre more for petrol depending on which forecourt they use, Deeside.com’s fuel tracker shows. Asda Queensferry was selling unleaded at 159.7p a litre on Tuesday morning. Two other Asda forecourts in the county, Asda Singing Kettle and Asda Wylfa in Mold, were charging 172.9p and 171.9p.

stories.title: Man wanted since 2023 over Chester drugs investigation arrested in Thailand
stories.summary: A man wanted for almost three years over drug supply in Chester has been arrested in Thailand.
